reviews.text:
Lori is a fantastic dog walker! She was very flexible with our schedules, always took great care of our Pepper, even helping her feel more comfortable with other dogs!
Lori went above and beyond, taking her to new places, always updating with photos. Definitely recommended urban tails and Lori.

Lori is absolutely the best! I always know my dog Syrus is in great hands the moment he’s picked up. She was such a lifesaver last year when I broke my foot and couldn’t walk long with my high-energy pup. Her help made a stressful time so much easier.

She’s incredibly communicative and always sends the most wonderful pictures and videos, which honestly become the highlight of my day. You can tell she genuinely cares about her dog pack 🐾

1000000/10 recommend!

My dog Baron always has a wonderful time with Lori. He enjoys spending time with her and I never have to worry about him because he treats it like his second home. Every time we get to her building, he is excited to see her and I can not recommend Lori enough. She is amazing at what she does and puts me at peace of mind when I require daycare.

Lori is the best!! She took care of my baby sapphire so well while I was away on vacation. I was hesitant to give my keys to someone I hadn’t met for over a month but I quickly learned that she is so sweet and trustworthy!

Totally recommended her for any pet related needs. I have an exotic pet and she exceeded my expectations. :)
Lori watched my cat while I was away for a week and she was great! She was super reliable, and she gave me daily updates on how my kitty was doing. Will definitely be using her service again!
Thanks for walking my dog and my dog looks forward to his walk all the time.

My dog absolutely loves Lori and her walks with the gang. My dog is reactive with a unique, shy personality, and Lori was very patient and kind to her as my dog got to know her. We are very grateful to have found this dog walking service.
I used Lori's services. She's fantastic with animals. It was near our hotel. She texted us every day with photos, videos, and messages to reassure us. But everything went well.
Lori was great. She kept us updated during our time away from the furbabies. Very happy we've found you!!
Thank you Anton! It was a pleasure having having Jake and Abby stay with us. Hope to see them again soon!

Lori is an incredible dog walker, and I couldn’t recommend her more! She always sent me pictures and videos from every walk, which made me feel so at ease knowing my dog was happy and well cared for. My puppy was always so excited to see her, which says everything about how kind and trustworthy she is. My two year old lab can be a handful and she handled all the walks with such grace!! Lori is reliable, professional, and truly cares about the dogs she walks. I’m so grateful for her and the amazing service she provides :)
Lori is reliable and kind, my dog loves staying with her. I received pictures and videos with lots of updates about his day. He is taken on a number of walks and cared for so well.

Lori is exceptional! Our dog Bear has been walking with her for almost a year now and we absolutely love her - and so does he! She is punctual, flexible, and is a great communicator. We couldn’t ask for a better walker for our boy!
Lori is best !

The best dog care and walker.
Excellent service.
She is a very kind lady with lot of love for animals.
I trust her so much with my pets over a decade now.
I recommend Urban Tail Dog and Pet Services from the bottom of my heart.
Again thank you so much for help and kindness for my dogs. I never worry when my dogs are in your care.
Emma Marshall
Thank you so much Daniel for the 5 star review! I love Casper & Franklin and appreciate you being an amazing client!
Lori is the best! She takes so good care of my dogs throughout the years. And she sends me the cutest videos so I’m able to see my dog playing around.  I totally trust her and Martini and I love her!
Lori’s compassionate dedication to animals is reflected in the care she provides
Great experience! We’ve hired Lori twice already and we trust her 100% with the cats and anything we need while we’re away from home.
Lori boarded my two dogs for 2 weeks. One of them doesn’t like ANYBODY and she loved Lori. A testament she is a true dog pro
